Vectoris.dev Engine Architecture

Built for production-grade vector infrastructure at planetary scale.

Sub-Millisecond ANN Retrieval

HNSW and IVF-PQ indexes deliver p99 latency under 5ms across billion-vector corpora with tunable recall targets.

Billion-Scale Memory Quantization

Product quantization and scalar compression reduce RAM footprint by up to 90% without sacrificing retrieval quality.

Dynamic Multi-Modal Embeddings

Unified embedding pipeline for text, image, code, and audio vectors with cross-modal similarity in a single index.

Hybrid Sparse-Dense Reranking

Combine BM25 sparse retrieval with dense vector scores for state-of-the-art hybrid search and reranking pipelines.

Zero-Downtime Index Mutation

Hot-swap index segments, add vectors in real-time, and rebuild graphs without interrupting live query traffic.

Enterprise Compliance & Vault

SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR-ready data vaults with field-level encryption and audit logging.

Interactive Telemetry Engine

Tune index parameters and observe simulated live performance metrics.
